text:
Priya: Heads-up — onboarding sample-app failing for a customer. The webhook list in the Ruby SDK returns an empty array even though REST shows webhooks. Onboarding flow blocks. Anyone seen this?

Dan: Hmm. Which Ruby SDK version?

Priya: 3.0.2. Repro steps: REST: 
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/webhooks'
# returns 3 webhooks
```
Ruby SDK: 
```ruby
client.webhooks.list
# => []
```

Omar: interesting. Could be scope/auth mismatch. Are we using the same token?

Priya: yes same token. Also tried REST via the sample-app env and it returns the webhooks. So token is fine.

Dan: Did you check the request that Ruby SDK emits? We had a regression where the Ruby serializer renamed `page_size` -> `limit` but not for list endpoints. Could that cause the service to return a fallback empty result?

Priya: proxy logs show Ruby call to /v1/webhooks without the header `x-tenant`. REST call includes it. But token is tenant-scoped and present. So SDK seems to strip custom headers on list endpoints.

Omar: that matches a bug we fixed in node last quarter. The middleware that copies extra headers wasn't applied to the new paginated-list base class in Ruby.

Priya: also seeing strange retry behavior: when REST returns 429 the Ruby SDK retries twice with exponential backoff, but REST client only suggests 1 retry for idempotent GETs. Ruby's extra retries cause webhook create race in onboarding (double-create attempt) because client code expects single retry.

Dan: Ugh. Two separate issues: header omission (-> empty result) and retry policy mismatch (-> double side-effects). Could be from gem defaulting to RetryPolicy v2 instead of v1.

Omar: quick workaround: set explicit headers in sample-app when using SDK: client.with_headers('x-tenant' => ENV['TENANT']).webhooks.list and pin retry to 1 via ClientConfig. Not ideal but unblocks onboarding.

Priya: I'll patch sample-app to call the REST endpoint directly if webhooks list returns empty and log a telemetry event. Hotfix in prod rollout?

CIbot: Created PR #8423: sample-app fallback to REST for webhooks list when SDK returns empty. CI passed on staging.

Dan: Good. Also open two GH issues in the ruby-sdk repo: one for header middleware missing on paginated list base class, one for retry policy default regression. Please include proxy logs and minimal repros.

Priya: filing now and assigning to @Omar for the header issue and @Dan for retry policy. Adding e2e that compares SDK vs REST for list endpoints and validates header parity.

Omar: on it. I'll add a unit test to ensure headers are preserved and a canary that runs against staging to detect drift.

Dan: I'll add a changelog note and ensure gem bump includes a flag to toggle to old retry behavior until we fix.

Priya: thanks team. Leaving the fallback PR open until SDK patch lands.

(Reaction: CIbot :white_check_mark:, Omar :eyes:)
